channel.title: ThoughtSo Updates
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 2.2.1
item.description:
ThoughtSo 2.2.1

  • Live transcript: the AI snapshot Update now shows "Loading model" and "Summarizing" phases with elapsed time, allows four minutes for a cold model load, says plainly when another AI task or low memory blocks it, retries once, pre-warms the model once live transcription is running, and logs every attempt so failures can be diagnosed.
  • A recorded meeting keeps its captured start time and length; a calendar-bound meeting no longer takes the event's planned start and duration after a calendar refresh.
  • The meeting note keeps being written during a recording (two-second debounce), and the Meetings list shows "Recording" rather than "Processing" for the active meeting.
  • When the selected meeting app is not running, the notice names the app for all supported apps, an error shown during a recording no longer flashes the overlay, and crash recovery keeps the fallback source information.
  • Settings: the layout CPU-budget test measures the minimum of three runs and skips on a loaded machine.

item.title: Version 2.2.0
item.description:
ThoughtSo 2.2.0

  • Redesigned app: a calm Home with Start dictation, Record meeting, Recent items and your next meeting; History as a chronological feed with times in the gutter, expand in place, Improved/Original and one Copy button; Meetings with Today and All meetings (This week, Last week, Earlier), a featured next meeting with its briefing, and a meeting record that reads Summary, Decisions, Next steps with one pencil per section; Insights with an honest typing-time comparison and the conversations you can return to; Settings reorganised into General, Dictation, Meetings, Privacy & Storage with a collapsed Advanced group and search.
  • Command Center (Option+E) opens as a compact palette with preset chips, then shows Original and Result side by side; Copy is the primary action, Replace selection only appears for an editable selection and names the app; Refine result works on the current draft.
  • Live transcript window gets a manual "AI snapshot" of the current discussion, You/Others attribution, search, Refresh/Back to live, Copy as Markdown and Ask bound to the exact question; closing the window never stops the recording.
  • Meeting recording starts faster: the live speech model stays resident and is warmed at launch and before calendar meetings, the recording indicator appears before the calendar lookup, microphone and system audio open together, and a meeting started while the previous one is still processing gets live text immediately.
  • When the selected meeting app is not running, recording captures all system audio and says so, instead of failing.
  • Deleting a meeting keeps it deleted after relaunch; recovery only restores meetings that were interrupted mid-recording.
  • Switching between History and Meetings no longer stalls on large histories (lazy rows, duplicate records removed, search precomputed).
  • Settings opens on General without delay; Text Processing shows all fields even when Improve is off; the meeting app picker shows the saved app immediately.
  • Speaker detection runs on the offline Community-1 engine, and can be re-run on a finished meeting from the transcript, which reprojects the labels onto the current text and shows a status caption.
  • Speaker detection now covers meetings up to 60 minutes, and records an outcome for every attempt instead of failing quietly.
  • Live transcript no longer loses the opening words of a meeting, and quiet word onsets reach the recognizer through a pre-roll buffer.
  • Live transcript breaks rows on sentences rather than mid-thought, keeps numbers intact, closes a speaker's row when the other channel takes a turn, and restores words a confidence filter had dropped.
  • Live transcript only deletes microphone echo when the audio supports it, and stopping a meeting during startup no longer leaves a stale pane.
  • Word timestamps from Parakeet no longer stretch past the audio they came from.
  • The System Health window stops hammering the logging daemon while open, and reports microphone status and hotkey collisions correctly.
  • About gains a third-party licenses and acknowledgements sheet.

item.title: Version 2.1.2
item.description:
Screenshot Reliability & System Health

  • System Health window (menu bar › More › System Health…): live status of every permission and prerequisite — Accessibility, Screen Recording, Microphone, Notifications, Secure Keyboard Entry, hotkey event tap, shortcut conflicts, app location — plus a built-in log viewer
  • Screenshots are also saved as PNG files to a folder on your Desktop (configurable in Settings › Recording)
  • Granting Accessibility while ThoughtSo runs now activates the shortcuts within seconds — no restart needed
  • Shortcut conflicts and disabled screenshot takeover are reported in logs instead of failing silently

item.title: Version 2.1.1
item.description:
Screenshot Reliability & Permissions

  • Clear permission guidance: pressing the screenshot shortcut without Screen Recording access now shows a notification that opens System Settings directly
  • Settings › Recording › Screenshots shows live permission status (Screen Recording and Accessibility) with one-click access to grant them
  • Screenshots taken right before stopping a dictation are no longer lost
  • Copying something yourself while ThoughtSo is pasting no longer loses your clipboard content
  • Screenshots always land at the correct position in dictated text, even when captures finish out of order
  • ThoughtSo's own recording overlay no longer appears in captured screenshots

item.title: Version 2.1.0
item.description:
Visual Dictation & Screenshots

Screenshots are now first-class citizens — while dictating and everywhere else.

  • Visual Dictation (experimental): press the screenshot shortcut while dictating and the capture is pasted inline into your dictated text, exactly where you took it
  • ThoughtSo takes over the macOS screenshot shortcuts while it runs: ⌘⇧4 selects a region, ⌘⇧3 captures the display under your pointer
  • Screenshots land straight on your clipboard — no floating thumbnail, no Desktop files; perfect with a clipboard manager
  • Prefer the macOS behavior? One toggle in Settings › Recording › Screenshots hands the shortcuts back
  • New onboarding step explaining the screenshot workflow

Reliability

  • Notes editor rebuilt on a solid foundation
  • Meeting history hardened against data loss; sync protocol fixes
  • Live transcript ordering fixes (capture-time timestamps)

item.title: Version 2.0.0
item.description:
Live Meeting Transcription

See the conversation as it happens — fully on-device.

  • Live rolling transcript in the meeting view while recording: your voice labeled "You", everyone else "Others"; first text ~8s after speech, updates every ~6s
  • Floating transcript window: movable, resizable, pinnable above full-screen Zoom/Meet on any Space; auto-open via menu bar → "Live Transcript Window"
  • Post-meeting, the live transcript is replaced automatically by the full speaker-diarized version
  • Crash-safe: live transcript persisted every 30 seconds
  • Echo protection on speakers: remote voices bleeding into the mic are deduplicated
  • Pure add-on to recording — live transcription failures never affect the meeting recording

item.title: Version 1.9.5
item.description:
Recording reliability — duplicate-stop fix

Critical fix for a 1.9.1 regression where clicking Stop twice could overwrite a recorded meeting with an empty result.

  • Explicit meeting lifecycle (idle/starting/recording/stopping/processing) with sessionID tracking — duplicate stops are no-ops
  • Capture audio is staged in ~/Documents/ThoughtSo/MeetingAudio/<id>/ before processing so it survives crashes
  • Recording-critical mode pauses KB indexing, workspace reparse, live insights, and Command Center LLM while a meeting captures
  • Capture-health telemetry on mic + system audio; silent dictation now skips STT and shows a clear mic warning
  • Partial captures are processed (mic-only or system-only) instead of failing entirely
  • AudioRecorder purpose split (dictation vs meeting) with distinct publish throttles
  • Bigger default main window (1280×820, min 960×640); cross-meeting chat hidden while retrieval is rebuilt

item.title: Version 1.9.0
item.description:
• Unified recording view: MeetingEditorView is now used during recording (replaces LiveMeetingView)
  • Recording banner with pulsing indicator, elapsed time, and stop button
  • Live transcript streams directly into Notes tab during recording
  • Prep, Notes, and Outcomes tabs accessible during recording
  • Auto-navigation to editor when recording starts (including from hotkey)
  • Short recording cleanup: skeleton meetings discarded for <5s recordings

item.title: Version 1.8.0
item.description:
• Fix local model thinking/reasoning leakage (Qwen3.5 additionalContext)
  • Redesigned settings into card-based UI with modular views
  • Unified design language across meetings views
  • Local LLM quality test harness
